2  THIS CCC IS FILED UNDER SECTIONS 11 AND 12 OF THE CONTEMPT OF COURTS ACT, 1971, R/W. ARTICLE 215 OF CONSTITUTION OF INDIA 1950, PRAYING TO PUNISH THE CONTEMNOR/ACCUSED FOR DISOBEYING THE ORDER OF THIS HON'BLE COURT IN W.P.NO.103011/2022 DATED 12/01/2024 AS PER ANNEXURE-A.

THE PRESENT CONTEMPT PETITION, TO THE PRESENT PETITIONERS CONCERNED ONLY AND KINDLY PASS ANY SUCH ORDER IN FOUR OF THE CONTEMPT COMPLAINANTS IN FACTS AND CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

-3-  NC: 2025:KHC-D:11261-DB  CCC No. 100050 of 2025 HC-KAR  THIS CCC COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.SUNIL DUTT YADAV  AND  THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIJAYKUMAR A.PATIL  ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.SUNIL DUTT YADAV) This contempt petition is filed asserting disobedience of the direction passed in W.P.No.103011/2022 as regards re-determination of compensation under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2. Learned Additional Government Advocate has filed an affidavit of the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Bagalkote District, Bagalkote, and has enclosed Document Nos. 1 and 2 which are the orders of re-determination.

3. Insofar as payment is concerned, perused para No.5 of the Affidavit filed, in which it is specifically stated that once the claimants submit vouchers along with KYC NC: 2025:KHC-D:11261-DB HC-KAR details, necessary steps would be taken for making payment.
4. Learned Additional Government Advocate submits upon instructions of the concerned that necessary payments would be made within a period of three weeks.
The said submission is taken note of.
5. In light of the same, the proceedings are dropped.

Sd/-
